title: Upscale with a real ESRGAN-family model
description: IMG09: an upscale is a model-driven reconstruction, not a higher-resolution capture. The export keeps the source resolution recorded in `values` (so 'native vs reconstructed' is answerable from the receipt) and the scaler's model name — this template does not itself do tiled processing (ImageUpscaleWithModel runs the whole frame at once); tiling is future work tracked in docs/spec/creator/WP11.md, not silently assumed here.
